_comment: OpenAgile supervisor example config. Copy to supervisor/config.json and edit. Relative paths resolve against the directory you launch `node supervisor/run.mjs` from. JSON cannot hold comments, so every field is documented in _fields.

_fields.mcpUrl: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint of the running OpenAgile MCP server, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp. Required.
_fields.mcpToken: Bearer token for the MCP endpoint (OPENAGILE_TOKEN on the server). Empty when the server runs without a token. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.
_fields.agentName: Identity this supervisor writes to the board as. Used for claims and passed as `agent` on every task write. Must stay stable across restarts so leases match.
_fields.boardId: The iteration (board) to drive. Provide this, OR a groupId/groupName with createBoardIfMissing. Required if no group is configured.
_fields.groupId: Group whose latest iteration this supervisor drives when boardId is omitted.
_fields.groupName: Alternative to groupId: resolve the group by name. Created when missing and createBoardIfMissing is true.
_fields.createBoardIfMissing: When true (default), create an iteration in the group if it has none. Ignored when boardId is set.
_fields.workerCommand: Shell command run once per task turn. Task context arrives via OPENAGILE_TASK_ID / OPENAGILE_TASK_KEY / OPENAGILE_BOARD_ID / OPENAGILE_TASK_TITLE / OPENAGILE_TASK_DESCRIPTION; stdout is captured as the report. Required.
_fields.workerCwd: Working directory for workerCommand. Defaults to the launch directory.
_fields.workerTimeoutMs: Kill the worker after this many milliseconds and treat it as a failure. Default 1800000 (30 minutes).
_fields.heartbeatIntervalMs: How often the supervisor heartbeats an in-flight task. MUST be well under 300000 (5 minutes) or the server watchdog auto-blocks the task. Default 120000.
_fields.heartbeatSummaryEvery: Journal a heartbeat line every N beats (plus the first beat and a final summary). Avoids one journal line per beat. Default 5.
_fields.journalPath: Append-only JSONL journal: authoritative audit trail, idempotency map and persisted lease table. Defaults to supervisor/supervisor-journal.jsonl.
_fields.maxConcurrentTasks: How many worker turns may run at once. Default 1 (single writer, one task at a time).
_fields.pollIntervalMs: How often the scheduler looks for ready work. Default 5000.
_fields.idempotencyPrefix: Prefix for deterministic idempotency keys recorded in the journal and passed to create_task/create_tasks. Default "supervisor".
_fields.casRetries: How many times a write re-reads the board seq and retries on a Conflict. Default 3.
_fields.requireReport: When true (default), a worker that exits 0 with an empty report is treated as a failure and the task is moved to Blocked instead of Finished — the board never records done for an unverifiable turn.
_fields.reportEvidencePattern: Optional regular expression (case-insensitive) that the worker's report must match before the task may reach Finished. Empty (default) disables the check. Use it to demand an evidence line, a command transcript, etc.
